bosses.name: Banseer Bivan
bosses.levelUpDesc: For the rest of the game, you may have two Items face up in your scorekeeping area.

bosses.name: Malakill
bosses.levelUpDesc: Take one of your Items (face-up or face-down) and place it under a Monster Room. That Room has +3 until it is destroyed or covered.

bosses.name: Franz
bosses.levelUpDesc: For the rest of the game, whenever you use an Item's Boss ability, draw a Spell.

bosses.name: Lady Vix
bosses.levelUpDesc: Take a face-up Item from a Hero in town or another player. Place it face up in your scorekeeping area.

bosses.name: Umbra
bosses.levelUpDesc: Look at all face-up Items in all players' scorekeeping areas. Choose one and place it face up in your scorekeeping area.

items.name: Mega Hammer
items.subtitle: Fighter Item
items.description:
Power-Up: Double this hero's Health.
Reward: Give one hero +2 for every Wound you have.

items.name: Minotaur's Mantle
items.subtitle: Fighter Item
items.description:
Power-Up: When this Hero is at the entrance to your dungeon, deactivate the first Fighter Room in your dungeon.
Reward: Choose one Room in your dungeon. Until end of turn, all Heroes pass through that Room twice.

items.name: Energy Bow
items.subtitle: Fighter Item
items.description:
Power-Up: This Hero ignores the last three Rooms of your dungeon.
Reward: Choose a Hero at the entrance to another player's dungeon. That Hero ignores the last three Rooms of the dungeon.

items.name: Tamer's Whip
items.subtitle: Fighter Item
items.description:
Power-Up: All your Monster Rooms have a base damage of 1 while this Hero is in (or at the entrance to) your dungeon.
Reward: Give one Monster Room in your dungeon +x damage until end of turn, where X is equal to the number of Monster Rooms in your dungeon.

items.name: Surprise Box
items.subtitle: Mage Item
items.description:
Power-Up: No one may play Spells while this Hero is in (or at the entrance to) your dungeon.
Reward: Discard your hand and draw Rooms and Spells, each equal to the number of each you discarded.

items.name: Portal Wand
items.subtitle: Mage Item
items.description:
Power-Up: This Hero skips one Room in your dungeon (beginning with the first) for every Spell card in your hand.
Reward: Choose a Hero in any dungeon. It skips the next Room it would enter.

items.name: Crystal Ball
items.subtitle: Mage Item
items.description:
Power-Up: When this Hero enters your dungeon, all players reveal their Spells. Discard any of your Spells that match those in other players' hands.
Reward: All players reveal one Spell (if they have one or more). Choose one revealed Spell and put it into your hand.

items.name: Flame of Achoom
items.subtitle: Mage Item
items.description:
Power-Up: This Hero ignores the ability text of all Rooms that modify the damage of other Rooms.
Reward: Until end of turn, your Rooms with Mage treasure give +1 to adjacent Rooms.

items.name: Lich Crown
items.subtitle: Cleric Item
items.description:
Power-Up: If this Hero would be killed in your dungeon, return it to town instead. You keep this Item.
Reward: Choose one face-down Hero. Do damage to another Hero equal to the chosen Hero's Health.

items.name: Shining Armor
items.subtitle: Cleric Item
items.description:
Power-Up: This Hero may not be targeted by Spells.
Reward: Take one Spell from the discard pile.

items.name: Heart Container
items.subtitle: Cleric Item
items.description:
Power-Up: If this Hero survives your dungeon, choose a face-down Hero in your scorekeeping area and flip it face-up.
Reward: Choose a face-down Hero in an opponent's scorekeeping area. Return it to the entrance of that player's dungeon with +3.

items.name: Angel Wings
items.subtitle: Cleric Item
items.description:
Power-Up: This Hero gains +x, where X is equal to the number of Souls you have.
Reward: Give a Hero +x, where X is equal to the number of Souls you have.

items.name: Divining Rod
items.subtitle: Thief Item
items.description:
Power-Up: This Hero gets +1 for every treasure type you have in your dungeon (including your Boss's).
Reward: Give a Hero +1 for every treasure type you have in your dungeon (including your Boss's).

items.name: Super Magnet
items.subtitle: Thief Item
items.description:
Power-Up: When this Hero is at the entrance to your dungeon, deactivate all Rooms in your dungeon with two or more treasure icons.
Reward: Choose a player and one treasure type. Until end of turn, Heroes ignore all icons of that type in that player's dungeon.

items.name: Blast Box
items.subtitle: Thief Item
items.description:
Power-Up: Destroy the Room this Hero dies in.
Reward: Destroy a Room in any dungeon with a Hero in it. That Hero is killed.

items.name: Secret Map
items.subtitle: Thief Item
items.description:
Power-Up: This Hero skips all Rooms that have treasure matching the treasure types of any Heroes at the entrance to your dungeon.
Reward: Switch the first and last Rooms of a dungeon.

items.name: Antifreeze
items.subtitle: Universal Item
items.description:
Power-Up: When this Hero is at the entrance to your dungeon, if your dungeon contains any deactivated Rooms, immediately destroy those Rooms.
Reward: Reactivate all Rooms in your dungeon. Draw a Spell for each Room reactivated.

items.name: Stolen Blueprints
items.subtitle: Universal Item
items.description:
Power-Up: The turn this Hero enters town, no one may build a Room with a treasure icon matching this Hero's.
Reward: You may immediately build an additional Room in your dungeon, even if it is a sixth Room. At end of turn, destroy all Rooms you built after using this Item.

items.name: Pandora's Box
items.subtitle: Universal Item
items.description:
Power-Up: If this Hero is at the entrance to your dungeon, you may choose another Hero at the entrance to your dungeon to immediately kill.
Reward: You must take this Item face-up. While this Item is face-up in your scorekeeping area, any new Items you gain must be turned face-down. Discard a Spell to turn this Item face-down.

items.name: Doppelganger Cloak
items.subtitle: Universal Item
items.description:
Power-Up: This Hero has Health equal to the highest (modified) Health value of any Hero in a dungeon or in town.
Reward: During the Build phase, choose one Hero in town and designate a treasure type. That Hero is lured only by that treasure type until end of turn.

items.name: Stun Gun
items.subtitle: Explorer Item
items.description:
Power-Up: Whenever this Hero survives an Advanced Monster Room, return that Room to your hand.
Reward: Each opponent must choose an Advanced Room and return it to his or her hand. This is only useable during the Build Phase.

items.name: Force Field
items.subtitle: Explorer Item
items.description:
Power-Up: This Hero takes two less damage from Advanced Rooms.
Reward: Choose a Hero in an opponent's dungeon. Until end of turn, it ignores damage from Advanced Rooms.

items.name: Laser Drill
items.subtitle: Explorer Item
items.description:
Power-Up: When this Hero enters your dungeon, choose a covered Room from each Room stack and bring it to the top of that stack.
Reward: Until end of turn, treat all your Rooms as if they were just uncovered.

items.name: Flying Saucer
items.subtitle: Explorer Item
items.description:
Power-Up: If your dungeon contains only ordinary Rooms, give this Hero +3.
Reward: Search the Room deck for an Advanced Room and put it into your hand.
